question: What union is expressed by revering the beloved who gave half to his own beloved?
premises: The deity is addressed as beloved
The deity gave half to his own beloved
Obeisance is offered to both aspects
inference: The divine union of beloved and consort sharing one form merits repeated obeisance.
plain_english: Repeated obeisance to the beloved, to his own beloved, and to him who gave half of himself.
